evidence.summary: SASTIND lists AECC among China’s defence-industry group companies (军工集团). AECC says it develops and builds military and civil aero-engines and gas turbines for aircraft, helicopters and large warships, and that it has contributed to building China’s defence weapons and equipment.

AECC says it was founded with capital from the State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission (SASAC), the Beijing state capital management centre, AVIC and COMAC, and has 27 directly held units, including seven research academies and institutes.
